facts.fact: Algeria's communications minister, with Niger's minister, chaired the official launch of operation of the trans-Saharan fibre backbone joining In-Guezzam (Algeria) to the Arlit-Agadez region (Niger) at Assamaka on 6 October 2026, with a stated capacity of up to 100 Gbps from the start, per APS.
